title: 📢Community Event: "What's on my desk?"
content:
## _Hello everyone!_

## _We are excited to announce our first community event:_

## **_"What's on my desk?" 🎉_**

This event is all about sharing the unique and creative setups of your workspaces. Whether it's your home office, studio, or any place where you get things done, we want to see it!  


* * *

# **How to participate:**

  1. Take a photo of your desk or workspace.

  2. Share it in **@General board as a post.**

  3. Add a brief description of your setup and any interesting items you have on your desk

  4. **Don't forget to add the tag "whatsonmydesk"!**




* * *

We can't wait to see your amazing workspaces! Let's connect with fellow community members and see how they work. 🖥️✨

** _Happy sharing!_**


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Wait, I need to clean up my desk first... 😵

Comment 2: It’s really exciting news! 🏄 If creative workspaces are shared, it will surely lead to a wealth of ideas and collaboration, inspiring even more remarkable outcomes. 👖 Does the workspace... or desk need to be specifically related to fashion, or can it be open to other fields as well?
Reply 1: Hi! It doesn't have to be related to fashion! Feel free to share anything on your desk that you want to share!💫
content_description: Join our community event "What's on my desk?" to share and explore the creativity behind your unique workspace setups!

title: CLO-SET File Download Problem
content:
After completing the rendering process, when I click the download button, a new tab opens with the message "Missing query parameter," and the download does not start. This issue does not occur when I click the download button for older render files, but I am experiencing this problem with all render files I create from now on.

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/561659185a454026b1afad83e927197c/images/74a16a363fbf477297e20f6b5d1638b4CC56A55B-2BE7-4AE5-AEBF-FEF83F16CD34.webp)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Thank you for your report. If there were special characters in the file name, there was an issue with downloading. It just has been fixed. Please check it again!

Comment 2: Hi, please send your query in to tech support here: https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/requests/new
content_description: This web page aims to address the issue of a "Missing query parameter" error when attempting to download newly rendered files, while older files download successfully.

title: How do I get waistband to stop clipping behind 2 layers offabric?
content:
Hello! I'm trying to make a piece that has a separate midsection, with a waistband on the top and bottom of the section. I'm having an issue with the waistbands clipping behind the mid-section. I've done superimopose(side), and set the order to be brought to front for the waistbands but I still can't fix the issue. I've provided pictures below, but please let me know if you need any more info to offer advice.

Thank you!!

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6e4dbc24ab7c468f8690d2bff27f7caf/images/e2b1ff61138e4db18acb2e9fb2a93663Screenshot%20%285%29.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6e4dbc24ab7c468f8690d2bff27f7caf/images/29e51cecf54d43178076a6f557e19979Screenshot%20%287%29.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/6e4dbc24ab7c468f8690d2bff27f7caf/images/035d79a4f3a44b709f6f9d2bdd7d7fe1Screenshot%20%286%29.png)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: What exactly is meant by this: "set the order to be brought to front for the waistbands"? The arrangement in the 3D window before simulation? You can use Set Sublayer: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013802288-Set-Sublayer-Pattern I opposite to setting the layer (PE) away from 0, it doesn't have to be removed. However, to get the pieces to come out, of course changing the layer is an option, but we recommend to remove it after the simulation has settled.
Reply 1: You're a gem, the sublayer tool worked best for what I'm trying to do. Will definitely keep this tool in mind.

Comment 2: Hi, I see the layer of the belt is 0. Have you tried changing the layer of belt to 1?
content_description: "Request advice on resolving waistband clipping issues in a garment design featuring a separate midsection."

title: Belated New Year wishes
content:
Hi guys,

Forgive me for being a bit too active here. Normally, I don’t like exposing myself in social media and I’m foreign to all the bragging that goes on in Instagram etc But this community is different: it feels genuine and comfortable and I’m so happy to be a part of it!

Nope, I’m not a 3D designer. Although my initial education that I got 30 years ago (yep, I’m nearly 51) was in fashion, I’ve been out of the industry for so long that I don’t dare to even consider myself a part of it. But I endlessly admire **all** and **every single one of you** for your desire to learn and ability to create. And I wish you all endless inspiration, strength, persistence in learning and achieving the new heights in 2025!

Sending you all tight hugs 🤗

Anna

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202501/68046ee39ecf4e3a86d6419eaf641545/images/80cfe23478ba4d3bb4e3e93231886921IMG_3115.jpeg)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: We’re so glad to have you here! Here’s to an inspiring and creative 2025! Big hugs! 🤗
content_description: A heartfelt message celebrating community, creativity, and mutual support among aspiring designers and artists.
